title: provisioning's app-sdk manifest is intentionally empty — no reconcile loop here
answers: Where is the provisioning app's reconcile loop?
Does apps/provisioning run its own app-sdk operator?
body: apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/manifestdata/provisioning_manifest.go is generated ('DO NOT EDIT') and declares `Versions: []app.ManifestVersion{}` — an empty manifest. This module does not run its own app-sdk controller/operator; the main module's pkg/registry/apis/provisioning does the real API-serving work using these Go types directly. Don't search apps/provisioning for a reconcile loop or controller registration — it isn't there.
applies: Applies when looking for an app-sdk controller/operator/reconcile loop for provisioning kinds. The real API-serving logic is in the main module, not in apps/provisioning.
